Breaking the Fourth Wall is awarded to players who defeat Fractillus after destroying a fourth wall 18 times in the Manaforge Omega on Normal difficulty or higher. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Omega Raider. To begin, start stacking up walls in one lane until four walls are present, then use Shattering Backhand to break them. Do not line up for a backhand on lanes with less than four walls present. Rinse and repeat eighteen times. Take care to not enrage the boss by letting too many walls stack up! An additional healer may prove useful for the incoming damage.

Caius Blackwood, most often simply referred to as C, is a powerful magic user. Though he works with the Syndicate to achieve his goals, and was known among them as a mage, his true allies are the Shadow Council. He has been known to observe a rogue adventurer for some time, eventually reaching out to them so they could steal the :Horn of Xelthos for him. He then asked them to retrieve the :Eye of Bhossca. This caught the attention of Ravenholdt Manor, who wanted to stop him from getting the :Talisman of Kazdor, the last artifact Caius needed. Following the Assassin's League's instructions, the adventurer booby-trapped the talisman, hoping that it would kill Caius. He never appears in person

Chimeric refers to a type of magic wielded by mages. It is a multi-school, combining the Arcane, Fire, and Frost schools. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.

The Circle of Ancients is a group of Ancients who meet at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. They at least have enough authority to make large decisions, such as pooling their powers to help Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and his druids in growing the new World Tree of Teldrassil. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade was sent to explore the ruins of Ameth'Aran and, after discovering information on Ameth'Aran's fall, delivered a report on her findings to the Circle. At some point, Velinde Starsong asked the Circle for help with the worgen that she had unleashed in Ashenvale, but they weren't able to help her.

Crafting stations (also crafting tables and profession tables) are profession‑specific workbenches introduced in used as tools for crafting recipes in the Dragon Isles proficiency and beyond. Some professions, such as Alchemy, also make use of portable remote crafting tables, allowing crafters to work away from fixed locations. Crafters can complete crafting orders for their profession from these stations. Additionally, NPC orders will show up and offer rewards in addition to gold. These stations are found in Valdrakken, Dornogal, and Silvermoon City. The Dye Station, located at the neighborhoods, is used for a specific pseudo-profession rather than one of the primary professions. File:Alche

Crawler Eggs are spider eggs found at Dredhollow in Revendreth when Funguss is up. Destroying them will spawn Dread Hatchlings. After all of the eggs in the area are destroyed, the Tomb Burster will spawn.

Crests are part of the item upgrading feature to increase the power of a given item during a season. Each season has its own set of crests and can be used to upgrade an item from that season along with the expansion-long currency such as Flightstones.

A Delver's Cosmetic Surprise Bag is available for free once per warband every season. Dhar Oztan is a crystal-covered mountain on the western peninsula on the Isle of Dorn. The Tranquil Strand is on the shoreline just to the east, and the Orecreg and Freywold Village lie to the southeast. Alunira can be found circling its peak. On the mountain is an old Stormrider outpost that predates the Stormperch. It was here that stormrooks were initially summoned to Azeroth through a massive storm caused by the clash of Durzan and Belzt, and it was here that they were summoned again after the death of Stormward Baelgrim and the loss of the Stormperch.

The Devouring War is a conflict which occured at least a hundred thousand years ago when the void lord Dimensius invaded the planet K'aresh. It culminated in the planet's destruction and the transformation of the native K'areshi into the ethereals and brokers, scattering them across the Great Dark Beyond and Shadowlands.

Drake's Dreaming Crest is used to upgrade Dragonflight Season 3 gear alongside Flightstones.

Once done, players can trade their Wyrm's crests up to Aspect's Dreaming Crests in a 6-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn in Amirdrassil.
